_comment: 급식소 fixtures for the 급식소 현황 table on 집사톡. `hoursAgo` is converted to a real `last_attended` Timestamp at seed time (relative to the seed run), so the freshness ramp renders an actual spread instead of one colour. `null` = no visit on record, which the table renders muted rather than as a point on the scale. Values are chosen to hit each region: fresh (blue), mid (purple), past the 48h urgency marker AND past the 60h clamp (red), and unknown.
